parameters.name: AmortizationPeriodFilter
parameters.description:
The filter for the amortization month.
Maximum number of elements: 10.

parameters.name: BillOwnerIdList
parameters.description:
The filter for the ID of the resource owner.
The resource owner is the account that actually uses the resource.
Maximum number of elements: 10.

parameters.name: BillUserIdList
parameters.description:
The filter for the ID of the bill payer.
This is the ID of a RAM user. If you specify this parameter, you can view the bills of the RAM user. If you leave this parameter empty, the bills of the current account and all its RAM users are returned.
Maximum number of elements: 10.

parameters.name: CostUnitCode
parameters.description: The code of the cost center.

parameters.name: InstanceIdList
parameters.description:
The filter for the instance ID.
You can query multiple instances. If you leave this parameter empty, all instances are queried.
Maximum number of elements: 10.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of data records to return in this call. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must set the value to the token that is returned in the previous call. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The product code.
To obtain the value of this parameter, call QueryProductList to query product information, or call DescribeResourcePackageProduct to query information about a specific resource plan.

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description:
The subscription type. Valid values:

- Subscription: subscription.

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.
